website.note: Corporate site describes the FDA-cleared Evoke / BNA (Brain Network Analytics) qEEG/ERP platform; no drug-pipeline page.

ctgov.note: No company-sponsored interventional P1/P2/P3 drug or device trials. Firefly's EEG analytics have been used as exploratory biomarkers in third-party industry studies (e.g., Novartis MIJ821 / onfasprodil Phase I, published 2023), but Firefly is not the sponsor and the asset is not its own.

products.name: Evoke System (BNA Platform)
products.type: FDA-cleared Class II medical device (qEEG / event-related potentials analytics)
products.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k) cleared (initial BNA Analysis System cleared July 2014 for ages 14-24; Evoke / BNA Platform commercialized as successor)
products.indication: Quantitative EEG and ERP analysis to support assessment across neuropsychiatric and neurological conditions; deployed at 85+ clinical sites.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Third-party Phase I study where Firefly's EEG analytics served as a CNS biomarker readout; the drug asset is not Firefly's.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Commercial-stage medtech / brain-health diagnostics company. The Evoke/BNA platform is FDA 510(k) cleared and marketed; the company has no proprietary drug assets and no active company-sponsored interventional P1/P2/P3 trials of its own device beyond commercial use.
